name: ANTI-PERFECT OVERSIZED TEE - COFEE BEIGE
description:
Size Note:Our oversized t-shirts run slightly big we recommend going one size down for the best fit.
Fit: Relaxed
Fabric: 100% cotton, 240 GSM Loop Knit
Model Size: Male - M, Female - S
Color:  Coffee Beige
How To Style:
The Coffee Beige Anti Perfect Tee Oversized T-shirt offers a clean, relaxed aesthetic. Pair it with Light or dark skinny jeans or cargo pants for a balanced look. Layer it under a denim jacket for a casual street-style vibe, or keep it simple with sneakers and a cap for an easy, laid-back outfit.
Wash Care:

Machine Wash at 86° F / 30° C
No Chlorine Bleach
Do not tumble dry
Maximum iron at 230° F / 110 °C
Dry Clean
Wash inside out and dry separately
